func:
if (!msg.batchState || !msg.batchState.lotNo) {
    node.error("BATCH LotNo missing");
    return null;
}

var lotNo =
    String(msg.batchState.lotNo).trim();

var sendDate =
    String(
        (msg.autoBatch && msg.autoBatch.sendDate) ||
        msg.sendDate ||
        global.get("sendAllRejectDate") ||
        ""
    ).trim();

if (!sendDate) {
    node.error("BATCH DateDepallet missing for " + lotNo);
    return null;
}

var safeLot =
    lotNo.replace(/'/g, "''");

var safeDate =
    sendDate.replace(/'/g, "''");

msg.topic = `
WITH R AS
(
    SELECT
        LotDepID,
        DateDepallet,
        DateReject,
        dt,
        ShiftID,
        CuringCnt,
        ToPackCnt,
        Rej_R01,
        Rej_R02,
        Rej_R03,
        Rej_R04,
        Rej_R05,
        Rej_R06,
        Rej_R08,
        Rej_R12,
        Rej_R13,
        Rej_R99,
        RecTime
    FROM PIS_REJECT
    WHERE LotDepID = '${safeLot}'
      AND CAST(DateDepallet AS date) = '${safeDate}'
),
Latest AS
(
    SELECT TOP 1
        DateDepallet,
        DateReject,
        dt,
        ShiftID,
        RecTime
    FROM R
    ORDER BY dt DESC, RecTime DESC
)
SELECT
    MAX(R.LotDepID) AS LotDepID,

    L.DateDepallet,
    L.DateReject,
    L.dt,
    L.ShiftID,

    SUM(COALESCE(R.CuringCnt,0)) AS CuringCnt,
    SUM(COALESCE(R.ToPackCnt,0)) AS ToPackCnt,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R01,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R01 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R01,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R02,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R02 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R02,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R03,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R03 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R03,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R04,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R04 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R04,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R05,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R05 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R05,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R06,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R06 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R06,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R08,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R08 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R08,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R12,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R12 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R12,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R13,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R13 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R13,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R99,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R99 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R99,

    SUM(
        COALESCE(R.Rej_R99,0)
    ) AS Rej_R99_Raw,

    L.RecTime

FROM R
CROSS JOIN Latest L

GROUP BY
    L.DateDepallet,
    L.DateReject,
    L.dt,
    L.ShiftID,
    L.RecTime
`;

node.status({
    fill: "blue",
    shape: "dot",
    text: lotNo + " | " + sendDate
});

return msg;
